- Sclerotinia would show white cottony growth with black sclerotia (hard bodies)
- Alternaria would show stem cankers without the gray fuzzy sporulation
- The combination of gray fuzzy sporulation + wilted/necrotic leaves + stem involvement is classic Gray Mold
